text:
marta: Pushing a small streaming-mode flip to `fast-path` on the EU canary. 8m after the flip we're seeing reconnect bursts + duplicate billing alerts for a few tenants. Anyone on this? :confused:

liam: got the alert ALRT-4001. p95 reconnects up on eu-west cluster. link: https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-4001

marta: logs show route-change then immediate resume on different shard, then a billed full-regenerate: 
```
2026-03-23T14:02:11Z INFO route-switch session=ff12 prev=eu-west-1 next=eu-central-1
2026-03-23T14:02:12Z INFO resume-accepted session=ff12 shard=eu-central-1
2026-03-23T14:02:12Z INFO reconnect-retry session=ff12 shard=eu-west-1
2026-03-23T14:02:13Z WARN quota.recheck session=ff12 reason=duplicate_resume
2026-03-23T14:02:14Z INFO billed_tokens session=ff12 tokens=53
```

anya: this looks like a classic race: client resumed to new shard while a fast retry hit old shard before cookie/affinity propagated. Our sampling for reconnect traces is tiny (0.5%) so the console didn't surface the per-shard spike until billing picked it up.

liam: short-term: increase reconnect sampling for EU to 10% for 20m and add a per-shard duplicate-billing tile to the canary dashboard. also enable a 20s soft-affinity to previous shard during mode flips.

marta: agree. longer term: add a cheap dedupe in billing keyed by resume_token+short-window (5s) to avoid quick double-charges. i'll open an RFC.

sre-bot: [automated] ALRT-4001 acknowledged by marta. Incident PM created: PMT-9002.

anya: small UX ask for product-console: show sampling fraction on rollout page with a CTA to bump during sensitive route changes. would have saved us time.

marta: actions:
- marta: bump reconnect.sample_frac EU -> 0.1 for 20m (doing now)
- liam: add per-shard duplicate-billing chart and watch query cost
- anya: draft billing-dedupe RFC (5s window)
- product-console: consider rollout sampling hint

liam: monitoring now, will post updates in 8m. :eyes:
